_comment: Benchmark manifest. Each entry is one project in the sample.
name     : label used in the report
source   : path to a project directory or .zip archive
stratum  : grouping label, so results are reported per stratum rather
than as one undifferentiated pool. Stratify on something you
expect to matter -- suite size, test style, domain.
inject   : how many known faults to seed before either arm runs. Seeded
faults are only placed in tests that currently pass.
max_tests: cap on failing tests attempted, to bound cost per project.
Scope reminder: projects needing databases, network access, native
extensions or non-standard build steps are out of scope. Run
`autef2 check <project>` first -- it costs nothing and tells you whether
